coverage_note: Tasklet review-safe authority proposal skeleton. RAK domestic and RAK↔Dubai are proposal candidates; Musandam/Khasab and Gulf capitals remain held-null until Grok exact-binds and range-gates them.

partner_context.their_ambition: RAKTA is positioned to modernize Ras Al Khaimah public transport as the emirate scales tourism, island/resort access, and links to the wider UAE.
partner_context.their_pressure: The hard problem is not another road shuttle; it is giving Al Marjan, Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra, RAK city, Dubai access, and northern-coast tourism a low-emission transport layer without overbuilding roads.
partner_context.where_navier_fits: Navier can become the authority marine layer: quiet scheduled links for residents and visitors now, with Musandam/Muscat/Doha/Bahrain held as phased Quanta-LR roadmap options.

hero.eyebrow: Authority proposal draft · Grok seal required
hero.title: A low-emission marine mobility layer for Ras Al Khaimah and the northern Gulf
hero.subtitle: Start with RAK domestic resort/city access and RAK↔Dubai connectivity; hold Musandam and Gulf capital routes until exact registry, range, and render QA are sealed.

why_now: The Gulf already has dense waterfront demand, constrained road access at peak moments, and public-sector decarbonization mandates. Navier adds a near-silent electric-hybrid foiling layer using existing waters and berths first, with Quanta-LR roadmap legs held until range, registry, and operations gates are sealed.

why_navier_now.step_change: Hydrofoiling is a step-change in comfort, speed, wake, noise, and efficiency versus conventional small craft, making marine mobility credible as a scheduled public layer rather than a novelty ride.
why_navier_now.no_new_infrastructure: The first deployments use existing waterfronts, marinas, ferry terminals, and resort arrivals; no new right-of-way or vertiport-style infrastructure is required for the proposal case.
why_navier_now.the_moment: GCC authorities are modernizing public transport while waterfront districts, resorts, and cross-border business links are growing faster than road corridors can absorb.

multimodal_fit: RAKTA can treat Navier as the water layer in an authority network: first/last-mile road access stays on land while waterfront-to-waterfront trips move by foiling vessel between city, resort, marina, and inter-emirate nodes.

differentiation.headline: Authority-safe modernization without overclaiming the map
differentiation.body: The proposal separates commercial-now local RAK / Dubai candidates from exact-bind-required Musandam and Quanta-LR Gulf roadmap legs. It is intentionally null where the registry, route ID, or economics are not sealed.

proof_points.claim: The shared UAE/Gulf spine already carries 60 RAKTA-usable geometry-present corridors before exact-bind cleanup.
RAKTA scope is explicitly RAK domestic, RAK↔UAE emirates, then Musandam/Muscat/Doha/Bahrain as roadmap.
RAK↔Musandam/Khasab is not proposal-ready display until exact registry treatment is done.
proof_points.evidence: Tasklet/Grok guardrail preserved in route seal ledger.

objections.q: Are Musandam and Oman ready to show as commercial routes?
objections.a: No. They remain exact-bind-required / Quanta-LR roadmap until Grok promotes Khasab/Musandam to the correct registry and clears cross-border operations.

objections.q: Are long Gulf legs N30 routes?
objections.a: No. RAK→Muscat/Doha/Bahrain stay Quanta-LR roadmap and visually distinct from N30 commercial-now candidates.
No. Authority economics should be built after route IDs are sealed so the Sheet, JSON growth block, sidecar, and route chips agree.

revenue_potential.headline: The floor and the prize — every rung traces to grounded, sourced demand.
revenue_potential.modal_lead: We start from grounded corridor demand. Each step adds one realistic expansion lever — network width, induced demand, and journey wallet.
revenue_potential.anchor_note: $8M/yr premium sea-transfer spend on sourced corridors today — the anchor every rung builds from.

whose_money_legend.navier_transport_revenue: Fare the Navier boats collect. This is the corridor P&L (atom.py). SOM/SAM rungs are in this unit.
whose_money_legend.journey_gmv: Total spend on the whole island journey flowing through the super-app: transport + food + stays + experiences + ads + parcel/logistics. Gross, all merchants. TAM rung is in this unit.

revenue_potential.cite_rule: Cite MID. 'High' stacks every optimistic assumption — ceiling, not headline.

rungs.label: SOM — floor (published)
rungs.basis: sourced flagship corridors · 10% capture · today's demand

rungs.label: SOM — full network
rungs.basis: whole mapped network · 10% capture · today's demand (no growth assumed)

rungs.label: SAM — matured network
rungs.basis: faster, more comfortable boats grow the market · leading-operator 25% capture, network-wide

rungs.label: Marine mobility TAM — induced marine-transfer market
rungs.basis: SAM divided by leading-operator capture — the full inducible water-transfer wallet at network maturity

rungs.label: Journey GMV — food + stays + experiences (≈3× TAM)
rungs.basis: add food, stays, and experiences to every crossing in the induced market

phase_economics.headline: Revenue potential by phase — conservative floor first, ecosystem prize last.
phase_economics.conversion_note: Fleet & CO2 scale from the grounded unit: 3 boats = $1M transport rev = 288 t CO2/yr (~$256K rev/boat).

vessel_sizing.headline: Right vessel for every leg — corridor range picks the hull.

classes.role: Capillary corridors ≤ 70nm. The workhorse of Prove + Scale.
Doubles throughput per hull on dense corridors; roughly halves payback. Scale-phase workhorse.
Regional legs 75–150nm beyond Pioneer range. Held out of near-term numbers.

vessel_sizing.range_gate_note: ≤ 70nm → Pioneer II (now). 75–150nm → Quanta-LR (roadmap). Long legs never faked on a 70nm boat.

_render_chip_flag.confidence_display: Tag every banded rung; lead with floor + corridor COUNT (ID-traceable). Never headline the 'high' band.

growth_case.modal_lead: We start from grounded corridor demand. Each step adds one realistic expansion lever — network width, induced demand, journey wallet, platform take.
growth_case.modal_headline: Floor to prize — every rung traces to grounded demand

ladder_transitions.headline: Same 10% capture, expanded to the full mapped network
ladder_transitions.basis: Width-only step. Capture rate held at 10%; corridor set expands from sourced flagships to the full mapped network.

ladder_transitions.headline: Network matures: faster, more comfortable boats grow the market + leading-operator capture
ladder_transitions.basis: Two-lever step. (1) Faster, more comfortable boats grow the cross-water market (induced demand). (2) Leading-operator capture lifts share from 10% floor to 25% mature, network-wide.

ladder_transitions.headline: Lens shift: Navier captured share → total inducible marine-transfer wallet
ladder_transitions.basis: Unit change. Divide SAM (the captured share) by leading-operator capture rate to recover the full inducible water-transfer market — the marine-mobility TAM.

ladder_transitions.headline: Marine transfer → total journey wallet (food, stays, experiences, in-app ads)
ladder_transitions.basis: Journey-wallet step. Each $1 of marine-transfer spend unlocks ~$3 of broader journey GMV across merchants the partner monetizes.
